title: Apply the approved initial private EKS baseline
expected_outcome: Apply only a reconfirmed baseline-only Terraform plan in account 106760547719, then verify the persisted state and essential private-network invariants without accessing workloads, Vault, or secrets.
constraints: Inputs must remain enable_release_signer=false and enable_release_signer_ecr_mirror=false.
Apply only if a fresh saved plan has exactly 99 creates, no changes or destroys, passes the boundary and scope gates, and matches the approved account.
Do not create ECR/release resources, mirror images, access Vault/EKS workloads, alter secrets, or record raw state/plan data.

external_actions: read AWS provider and backend state through the approved Terraform role
create a temporary saved Terraform plan
apply the exact reconfirmed initial private baseline Terraform plan
read back Terraform state and non-sensitive AWS resource metadata for verification

primary_owner.responsibility: apply boundary, security, cost, and final integration

delegations.escalation_trigger: fresh plan differs from approved 99-create scope or shows a destructive action
verification requires secret, workload, or unapproved account access
